description.narrative: (Ethiopia): The Malaria Diagnosis and Treatment Activity improves the quality of malaria diagnosis and treatment services in both public and private health facilities. The activity will strengthen partnerships and coordination at national and regional levels; strengthen and scale up quality assurance (QA) systems for malaria diagnosis and treatment; improve infrastructure (minor renovation) and human resource capacity for malaria diagnosis and case management...MDTA will expand its implementation to facilities in 30 districts in Somali Region and additional 23 districts from Oromia and Amhara regions, bringing the total number of districts to 203.....
